moats.claim: Project/time history, organization roles and report-sharing create moderate workflow switching costs, with the core timer itself offering limited barriers to imitation.

productReasons.claim: Calendar/timesheet editing and desktop activity/idle detection make filling time records easier across different work styles.
Project rates and budgets update spend as hours accumulate, helping teams monitor delivery cost.
Multi-level report grouping, shareable read-only links and PDF/CSV/Excel exports support client and finance reporting.

sponsorship.notes: No separate corporate financial/in-kind sponsor identified in reviewed official project and business pages. Verified commercial steward included as business fallback; customers, partners and investors are not classified as sponsors.

requirements.notes: Official image bundles PHP/application/web runtime; manual host PHP stack not required for container route.
